name: clipzyme_directed_reaction_novel_fallback_contract_v1
purpose: Provide a performance-blind fallback if the unordered ReactZyme reaction_smi split cannot supply at least 50 native official-CLIPZyme reaction queries without inventing substrate/product direction.

authoritative_external_baseline.name: CLIPZyme
authoritative_external_baseline.implementation: released official CLIPZyme code/checkpoint and native reaction/protein encoders

selection_policy.rule: Choose the first priority cell with at least 50 official-CLIPZyme-compatible directed reaction queries after performance-blind input support checks. Do not compare cell performance before selection.

priority_cells.reason: Closest task alignment to the intended ReactZyme reaction-novel comparison while retaining real directed reaction records; existing CLIPZyme train-overlap audit found 0/329 unique test reactions seen in the reconstructed CLIPZyme train split and only 109/8957 exact test sequences seen.
Independent temporal strict-double-cold fallback with real directed reactions; existing CLIPZyme train-overlap audit found 0/810 unique test reactions seen.

Broader reaction-cold fallback with real directed reactions and 0/744 unique test reactions seen by the reconstructed CLIPZyme train split; retained only if both strict-double-cold cells lack enough native CLIPZyme support.

native_support_requirements: reaction_id resolves to the independently recorded directed reaction_smiles in the frozen general merged registry
RXNMapper preprocessing succeeds without target-performance filtering
official CLIPZyme graph prerequisite is satisfied: all atoms mapped uniquely and reactant/product map sets identical
reaction is absent from the reconstructed CLIPZyme author training split under undirected canonical matching
protein is available in the released CLIPZyme screening registry or through official author-native protein inference
common_support_rule: Direct CLIPZyme-vs-Catalyst deltas use exactly the same frozen candidate/query support. Catalyst adapts upward to the baseline support; CLIPZyme receives no Catalyst features, experts, router, retraining or target-specific repair.

reveal_and_promotion_boundary.role: descriptive baseline alignment and capability coverage; fresh promotion claims still require a newly unrevealed external benchmark

tiger_role: methodology/reference only; never baseline numbers or executable backstop
rejected_paths: replacing the official CLIPZyme reaction encoder with MAT/UniMol/RDKit to enlarge support
choosing among fallback cells by whichever gives Catalyst the largest delta
repairing unsupported CLIPZyme inputs with Catalyst representations
resuming E2R Rescue V2 tuning on its already-used development split
